messages.author: 59a50764ec95c799
messages.subject: Re: Rotate text in gheatmap
parts:
I have a tree that is grouped and colored by this:

annot_tree <- groupOTU(hc_tree, hc_cls, group_name="hcfamily")

and is then associated with a matrix, as in your advanced annotation example. I am able to correctly display the combined result. However, when I try to then rotate the matrix column labels as described in this post, I get the following error:

"Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'hcfamily' not found"

Specifically the code is:
> hm<-gheatmap(p, clean_data, offset=1.5, width=0.5)+ theme(legend.position="none") + geom_text2(aes(color=hcfamily, label=HCfam), hjust=-4, vjust=0.6, size=3)
> df = get_heatmap_column_position(hm,by="bottom")
> hm + geom_text(data=df, aes(x,y,label=label), nudge_y = -1, angle=45)
"Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'hcfamily' not found"

Any suggestions would be appreciated, thank you.

-Mark

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Rotate text in gheatmap
parts:
You just need to add `inherit.aes=FALSE` to your last command:

p2 + geom_text(data=df, aes(x, y, label=label), nudge_y=-1, angle=45, inherit.aes=FALSE)
On Wed, Jul 6, 2016 at 2:41 AM, Mark Evans <talon....@gmail.com> wrote:

Thank you for providing the bug authoring guide. Below please find the link to the gist containing a reproducible example of the error I was asking about.
